I18NMgr.GetLocalizationKey(text) (code/decomp.next/NssMain/I18NMgr.c:2181): if IsChineseLetters(text) key = CRC64.ComputeCrc(text) else the text itself. CRC64.ComputeCrc (decomp.next/NssMain/CRC64.c): UTF8 bytes -> CRC64.Compute (table-driven, init all ones, shift-left-by-8 with high byte index, final bitwise NOT) -> ulong formatted as 16 hex digits zero padded (ToString x16-style, pad 0x30). Matches 16-hex m_key values in prefabs (e.g. edf85586064b8f4a) and PreLoadKeys.txt. Table values s_CRC64Table are in metadata static data, polynomial not printed.
